authority.statement: The notice and locator grant no permission or authority.

boundaries: This notice is communication evidence only and grants no permission, approval, promotion, or execution authority.
Do not infer registry release, promotion, publication, release, deployment, production readiness, or canonical authority from candidate-local prototype evidence.
Do not skip or defer any validation declared by the finite candidate-local Work Pack.
Keep generated admission projections non-authoritative and preserve the existing owners for canonical plan, material bytes, approval, one-SWU execution, continuation verification, and closeout.
key_points: Option A permits direct execution of the finite candidate-local Work Pack without pausing for per-SWU lifecycle choreography; it does not authorize capability promotion or canonical authority changes.
All Work Pack validation remains mandatory, including declared unit, integration, generation, scoped whitespace, and browser acceptance checks.

Deferred governance includes hardening Invoke, Structured Interview, and Decision Gate receipts; per-SWU Task Session, Invoke Refresh, and Continuation Router choreography; and any registry, promotion, publication, or release work.

The prototype evidence ceiling remains candidate-local: completion cannot be described as synchronized governance, publication, release, deployment, production readiness, or proof of future runtime success.

next_actions.action: Inspect the consolidated prototype validation report and candidate artifacts after prototype completion.
Use a separately authorized Spellcraft reflect/validate route to assess the one-shot admission prototype and define the required lifecycle reconciliation.
Reconcile upstream receipt hardening and per-SWU Task Session, Invoke Refresh, and Continuation Router choreography before making governed execution claims.
Gate registry, promotion, publication, and release separately; none is authorized by this notice.

open_calls.question: After prototype completion, how should the candidate evidence be reconciled into the governed lifecycle without treating this notice or its locator as authority?
